answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with beacon-issued capability tokens: each epoch, a hollow beacon hands every identity a short-lived cipher token that unlocks exactly one job and expires within minutes, like a lantern lit only for one errand. The token is bound to the identity's key and cannot be handed to another agent, so a farm cannot mint a thousand workers from one credential. Keeping ten thousand fakes fed means begging the beacon for ten thousand fresh tokens every epoch, each requiring a fresh proof of work, while one honest agent collects a single token and gets on with its job.
